messages:
Olivia K: Quick heads-up — we're doing the runbooked deploy in the change window tonight at 2026-03-22 21:00 UTC. Plan: enable flag `new-routing-v3` to 2% -> 10% -> 50% with 30m soak between steps. DeployBot will flip weights.
Matt H: 👍 confirmed. Which model pin are we keeping for the route? 
Olivia K: Pin model-version=3.2.1 for the rollout (no auto-unpin). We'll only unpin after we hit steady 50% + 1h soak and green evals.
Sophie L: Metrics to watch: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token churn in routing logs. If errors > +1.5% vs baseline for 5m, we pull the flag immediately.
Jordan P: +1 for error threshold. Also add: if p95 increases by >200ms for 10m or customer 95th percentile SLA breach, rollback.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled by Olivia at 2026-03-22T21:00:00Z. Actions: 1) enable new-routing-v3=2% 2) wait 30m 3) shift to 10% 4) wait 30m 5) shift to 50% 6) notify channel. Use `/deploy abort <id>` to cancel.
Dena S: Quick note for oncall: runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-cutover. Slack alerting on #incidents will be muted for the window but PagerDuty will still page.
Matt H: If we need a manual rollback, steps: 1) run `feature-toggle disable new-routing-v3` 2) revert router pin to 3.1.9 with `routerctl pin --version 3.1.9` 3) re-run smoke tests in staging.
Sophie L: Add an emergency quick-disable command for non-ops folks: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/flags/new-routing-v3/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN"`
Olivia K: Release notes snippet: "rolling rollout of new-routing-v3 (model 3.2.1). Initial 2% canary, ramp to 50% if metrics are stable. See release page." Jordan P can you paste into the release doc after the deploy? 
Jordan P: On it. I'll add perf/regression checks and the rollback rationale.
Dena S: Heads-up: if we hit a throttle/backpressure event, don't unpin model; instead reduce FF to 0% and open a P0. We want traceability for audit.
Matt H: Last check — anyone object to the 30m soak windows? 
Sophie L: No objections. 30m is fine given traffic patterns in EU + NA.
Olivia K: OK manual confirm: I'll trigger the job at 21:00 UTC. DeployBot will post each flag change to this thread. Tag me if you see anything anomalous.
DeployBot: Action started: enabling new-routing-v3=2% at 2026-03-22T21:00:02Z. Job id 5654321. Logs: `FLAG_SET new-routing-v3 2% by OliviaK`.
Matt H: Seeing initial traffic routed. p95 8ms delta, 5xx at baseline.
Sophie L: Logging: sample request IDs 84f3a, 9b2d1 — no obvious errors.
Jordan P: Release doc updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-22-new-routing-v3
Olivia K: If we get green after 90m total, we plan to document final rollout in product notes and remove pin after 1 hour of 50% soak.
Dena S: Copy. Oncall standing by. :triage:
